headline: Fire breaks out at drug factory in Tongi, thick smoke billows
summary: A fire erupted at a drug manufacturing facility in Tongi, sending plumes of dark smoke into the sky. Emergency services are on the scene.
details: A fire broke out at a drug factory in Tongi, Gazipur, on Tuesday afternoon. The blaze quickly intensified, producing thick black smoke visible from afar.
Fire service units have been dispatched to the scene and are working to control the fire. The cause of the fire is currently unknown, and there are no immediate reports of casualties.
The factory is located in a densely populated industrial area, raising concerns about the potential spread of the fire and its impact on surrounding businesses and residents.

headline_marked: [[Fire engulfs]] Tongi pharmaceutical factory; 19 fire engines battle blaze
headline: Fire engulfs Tongi pharmaceutical factory; 19 fire engines battle blaze
summary: Thick smoke billows from Drug International Limited's factory in Gazipur's Tongi after a fire broke out Tuesday morning. Emergency services are on the scene.
details: A fire erupted at a pharmaceutical company's factory in Gazipur's Tongi on Tuesday morning. The incident at Drug International Limited was reported around 10:15 AM.
Nineteen fire service units are currently at the scene, working to control the blaze. The cause of the fire and the extent of the damage are yet to be determined.
caption:
Massive fire breaks out at a pharmaceutical factory in Tongi, Gazipur. 
19 fire engines are battling the blaze.

A fire erupted at a pharmaceutical company's factory in Gazipur's Tongi on Tuesday morning. The incident at Drug International Limited was reported around 10:15 AM.

Nineteen fire service units are currently at the scene, working to control the blaze. The cause of the fire and the extent of the damage are yet to be determined.
